resume_rules: Default headline: BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER | [job-relevant specialization].
Use a different primary headline only when materially more appropriate; Personal Assistant only for assistant-based jobs.
Never invent employers, metrics, software proficiency, certifications, legal/insurance experience, or responsibilities.
Do not include independent crypto calls/community or Nothing Bundt Cakes unless explicitly enabled for that job.
Keep claims defensible and concrete; avoid generic AI-sounding language.
Tailor summary, skills and bullets to the job description while preserving factual history.
Use Philadelphia, PA only, not a street address.
Output should be concise and ATS-friendly, normally two pages.
